source_instruction: i would like a corgi dog cosmetic bag for my nail art.
query: I spent my entire walk to the corner boba shop this morning laughing at that viral video of a tabby cat stealing a whole slice of pepperoni pizza off a diner’s plate and darting under a parked food truck. I stopped mid-sip of my taro milk tea to rewatch it three times, and I still can’t get over how the cat didn’t even drop the pizza when it hopped over a curb. I’ve also been trying to remember if I left my favorite lavender lip balm in my friend’s car last weekend, since I rummaged through my jacket pockets and my desk drawer at work and can’t find it anywhere, and it had that cute little daisy charm on the cap I got at the craft fair last spring. Anyway, I’m browsing the bags & cases section right now, can you help me find something with nail art designs that’s under $20?
